h1: Drinkware Tooling: Existing Molds or New Cup Shapes
lead: Use an existing model when its shape and configuration meet the project. Develop tooling when the requirement changes the product shape or structure.
html:
Separate artwork changes from structural changes

Adding a logo is not the same task as changing the cup geometry. Identify whether the brief changes the artwork, one component or the complete vessel before deciding the tooling route.

Define tooling in the project quotation

Record the design version, material, structure and sample-approval stage. Tooling cost, production configuration and ownership arrangements belong to the specific project agreement.
